items.title: Queenslander could face death penalty over alleged killing of Australian in Syria
items.description: A 20-year-old Gold Coast mobile phone technician is facing a possible death penalty in Syria for the alleged shooting murder of another Australian.

items.title: Investors gave Capital Guard $17 million for a bond scheme that didn't exist
items.description: Everyday Australians who invested their retirement savings and inheritances with a wealth management company fear they have lost everything after the company's licence was cancelled for selling bank bonds that didn’t exist.

items.title: Breaking: Mother attended police station day before murder-suicide, search for baby called off
items.description: The mother at the centre of the horrific murder-suicide in South Australia's South East attended a police station the day before she and her daughter were found dead, police have confirmed.

items.title: Inflation softer than expected in June but still 'uncomfortably high'
items.description: Headline inflation was softer than expected in June, but the RBA could still debate what to do with interest rates next month.

items.title: Staffer to whom Brittany Higgins first confided rape allegation settles case
items.description: A former political staffer has settled a contentious lawsuit with the Commonwealth over claims her workplace rights were compromised in the fallout of Brittany Higgins's rape allegation.

items.title: One Nation asked to submit three years of missing financial statements
items.description: The Office of Fair Trading confirmed that One Nation Queensland Division Inc had until midway through next month to file audited accounts for the financial years from 2023 to 2025.

items.title: Drone captures rare video of 'magical moment' whale birth
items.description: A drone operator has captured video of a humpback whale giving birth, one of only a handful of people to film the phenomenon.

items.title: Local transmission of H5 bird flu confirmed in Australia
items.description: Federal agriculture minister Julie Collins says "local transmission has occurred" between greater crested terns infected with H5 bird flu in South Australia.

items.title: Woman born after IVF error hopes for change after legal action launched
items.description: The biological parents of twins who were born after an IVF embryo mix-up at Royal North Shore Hospital in Sydney have launched civil action.

items.title: Taiwan to stop buying PNG gas on spot market over 'One China' spat
items.description: Taiwan suspends some liquefied natural gas purchases from Papua New Guinea as part of an escalating diplomatic dispute over the future of its representative office in Port Moresby.

items.title: NT Aboriginal groups accuse CLP of 'weaponising' Closing the Gap funding
items.description: Aboriginal groups have renewed calls for the Commonwealth to overhaul its funding arrangements with the Northern Territory government, accusing the Country Liberal Party of "weaponising" federal Indigenous disadvantage funding against Aboriginal Territorians.

items.title: Resident describes earth 'ripping itself apart' as quake hit Japan
items.description: Thirteen people have now been confirmed dead after a magnitude-7.1 earthquake hit Japan's south.

items.title: US and Saudi Arabia strike Iran-backed militants after 'surprise attack'
items.description: Fresh fighting has erupted after the US accused Iran of launching its first ballistic missile attack on an American base since strikes were paused on Friday. Here's your three-minute briefing on the key developments in the Middle East overnight.

items.title: Taylor denies giving money to group at centre of NSW corruption probe
items.description: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption has seen a series of text messages in which key figures discuss a plan to "shake down" Angus Taylor for financial support.

items.title: Men on why they are choosing not to have children
items.description: What readers have to say about being childfree after our story on why more men are turning away from fatherhood.

items.title: Cards and gifts flood 99yo man as family posts social media call-out
items.description: When a social media appeal went out for birthday wishes, Cliff Kimlin's family never imagined it would bring rugby league legends Alfie Langer and Petero Civoniceva to the birthday celebrations.

items.title: Miles Franklin shortlist defies 'shaggy' trend in Australian publishing
items.description: ABC experts unpack the shortlist of Australia's biggest book prize: who made it, who missed out and who they think will win.

items.title: Cult inquiry recommends outlawing coercive control in groups
items.description: A Victorian inquiry into the recruitment methods and impacts of cults and organised fringe groups is recommending world-leading laws against group coercive control.

items.title: Chef appeals against sentence in 'horrific' murder at Canberra zoo
items.description: It remains one of the ACT's most significant sentences, with Chief Justice McCallum stopping short of sentencing the offender to life in jail.

items.title: 'Maniac' driver jailed after killing girl in horror crash near Geelong
items.description: A driver who was high on drugs when he crashed into a Victorian family's car and killed a 12-year-old girl has been jailed for 16 years.

items.title: Police officer stabbed in neck, alleged attacker shot in leg in Adelaide's north
items.description: A South Australian police officer has been seriously injured in a stabbing and her alleged attacker has been shot by police in Adelaide's north this morning.

items.title: Man who allegedly filmed two decades of sexual abuse to stand trial
items.description: A southern NSW man is set to stand trial accused of filming himself raping and assaulting a woman over nearly two decades, with lawyers saying they have "mental health concerns" of showing the footage to a jury.

items.title: Without more oil a new refinery makes no sense
items.description: Experts say a new refinery would still need to use imported oil and question how it would be competitive.

items.title: PM's data centre plan may hit roadblock as energy debate heats up
items.description: As two energy ministers oppose the prime minister's plan for national AI rules for data centres, the question over how to power the facilities intensifies.

items.title: Judge slams law firm over delayed $120m payout to sacked Qantas staff
items.description: Maurice Blackburn Lawyers has been handling a $120 million payout that Qantas agreed to pay its illegally sacked workers in 2024, with a judge rebuking the delayed compensation.
